transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um... I guess things have just been a bit much at work lately. The district put this new bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on my plate, on top of my regular teaching. 

I mean, I still get through the day, but I just feel... wound up. And discouraged, I guess, which isn't really like me. I've started putting off my lesson plans and emails... things I used to handle without a second thought. So... I just thought I should come in.
Have you been feeling more anxious or worried than usual, even when there’s nothing specific on your mind?
Um... no, not really. I mean, if I'm not thinking about school, I feel fine. It's mostly just... the work stuff.
Have you noticed that you’re not getting as much pleasure or interest out of the things you usually enjoy, like hobbies, time with family, or activities outside of work?
Um... no. I don't think so. I still do my usual things on the weekends, and... they're fine. Like I said, it's really just the school situation.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or having less energy lately, even when you're not doing anything particularly stressful at work?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I'm tired after a long day, but... just the normal amount, I think. I don't feel like I have less energy overall.
Have you felt down, sad, or hopeless more days than not lately, even outside of work stress?
Um... no. I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel... hopeless or anything. It's really just the stress at the school, like I mentioned. Outside of that, I'm... I'm fine.
Have you found it hard to relax or felt restless, especially when thinking about work?
No... not really. I mean, when I get home, I can just sit and read or watch TV fine. I don't really get restless.
Have you had any days where you felt like you couldn't cope or felt overwhelmed, even outside of specific work moments?
No... I wouldn't say that. I manage everything else fine. It's really just... the school. I don't feel overwhelmed with my normal life.
